items.scope: Vulnerabilities discovered by YesWeHack community hunters on products being tested on the platform with the permission of their owners, as part of Coordinated Vulnerability Disclosure.
Zabbix products and Zabbix projects listed on https://git.zabbix.com/ only.
All currently supported PTC software products and cloud/SaaS services.
All HDF software including HDF5, HDF4, HSDS, HDFView.
Vulnerabilities in software discovered by NCSC-FI, and vulnerabilities reported to NCSC-FI for coordinated disclosure, which are not in another CNA’s scope.
Dell, Dell EMC, and VCE issues only.

CVEs requested by code owners using the GitHub Security Advisories feature and vulnerabilities affecting open source projects discovered by security researchers at GitHub or Microsoft not covered by another CNA’s scope.
Vulnerabilities discovered by or reported to cirosec researchers that are not in another CNA’s scope.
Concrete CMS Core versions 8.5 and above.
All BlackBerry products identified on https://www.blackberry.com/us/en.
Vulnerabilities in third-party products discovered by ZUSO ART that are not in another CNA’s scope.
Vulnerabilities in AMI firmware and software products, as well as vulnerabilities discovered by AMI that are not covered by another CNA scope.
ELAN issues only.

Root Scope: Products and technologies of subsidiaries of Thales Group.
CNA Scope: Thales branded products and technologies, products and technologies of subsidiaries of Thales Group, unless covered by the scope of another CNA as well as vulnerabilities in third-party software discovered by Thales Group and subsidiaries that are not in another CNA’s scope.
Vulnerability assignment related to FSI’s vulnerability coordination role in the South Korea financial sector that are not in another CNA’s scope.
Proton AG issues only.
All IQSIGHT (formerly Bosch Building Technology - Video Systems) products including end-of-life products.
Products, services, and solutions developed by Canon EMEA, Canon USA Inc., and those from IRIS, NT-ware, Onyx Graphics Inc., and Therefore Corporation, which are not under the Canon Brand.
Teltonika Networks products and services only.
All Network Optix products, including https://www.networkoptix.com/nx-witness and https://www.networkoptix.com/powered-by-nx.
MongoDB products only, not including end-of-life components or products.
All Black Duck (formerly Synopsys Software Integrity Group) products, as well as vulnerabilities in third-party software discovered by Black Duck that are not in another CNA’s scope.
Bizerba products only.
Digi branded products and services only.
Vulnerabilities in all of Insyde Software’s firmware and software products, as well as vulnerabilities discovered by Insyde Software that are not covered by another CNA’s scope.
All products and projects in which OpenVPN is directly involved commercially and for OpenVPN community projects, including Private Tunnel.
Vulnerabilities in vendor products discovered by Securifera, or related parties, while performing vulnerability research or security assessments.

All products of Medtronic or a Medtronic company including supported products and end-of-life/end-of-service products, as well as vulnerabilities in third-party software discovered in Medtronic products that are not in another CNA’s scope.
Vulnerabilities in the following Altium products only: Altium Designer, A365, Octopart, and Altium Enterprise Server.
Synology issues only.
Citrix issues only.
Zscaler issues only.
Fuji Xerox and FUJIFILM Business Innovation products such as multifunction devices, printers, production printers, software, and cloud services.
Supported Milestone XProtect products.
Vulnerabilities in all Ubiquiti products and products of Ubiquiti subsidiaries only.

All products released by Teradyne Robotics subsidiaries, Universal Robots (UR) and Mobile Industrial Robots (MiR), including both actively supported and end-of-life/end-of-service products, as well as vulnerabilities in third-party software identified by Teradyne Robotics that are outside the scope of another CNA.
All automotive and related infrastructure vulnerabilities that are not in another CNA’s scope.
All Gallagher security products only.
Sirius branded products, managed systems, and software projects only.
Trend Micro supported products, including any end-of-life products.
Jaspersoft products and services only.

All products for Haverford Systems brands, PTZOptics and HuddleCamHD (supported products and end-of-life/end-of-service products), as well as vulnerabilities in third-party software discovered by Haverford Systems that are not in another CNA’s scope.
NVIDIA issues only.
Vulnerabilities in third-party software discovered by Bombadil Systems that are not in another CNA’s scope.
All Vaadin products and supported open source projects hosted at https://github.com/vaadin.
All Airbus products (supported products and end-of-life/end-of-service products), as well as vulnerabilities in third-party software discovered by Airbus that are not in another CNA’s scope.
openHarmony issues only.

Products and technologies branded by Bull and its subsidiaries, unless covered by the scope of another CNA as well as vulnerabilities in third-party software and hardware discovered by Bull and its subsidiaries that are not in another CNA’s scope.
ASR products only.
Hitachi products excluding Hitachi Energy and Hitachi Vantara products.
